base.name: Kokonut UI
base.usage: CardFlip is a showcase card (props: title, subtitle, description, features[]) — it flips on hover and renders its front face statically. TweetCard is a social-proof quote card (props: authorName, authorHandle, authorImage, content[], timestamp, href, optional reply={authorName, authorHandle, authorImage, content, timestamp}).

sections.name: Magic UI
sections.usage: Compose sections from these instead of hand-writing markup. BentoGrid takes children; BentoCard requires name and description (className, background, Icon as a component reference, href, cta optional). Marquee repeats its children (props: reverse, vertical, pauseOnHover, repeat). GridPattern/DotPattern/Ripple are absolute background layers: place as the first child of a relative parent, content after them (GridPattern: width, height, squares=[[x,y]]; DotPattern: width, height, cx, cy, cr; Ripple: mainCircleSize, numCircles). OrbitingCircles orbits its children (icons) around the parent's center (props: radius, duration, iconSize). AnimatedShinyText/AnimatedGradientText/AuroraText wrap a word or short phrase inside a heading, not whole paragraphs (AnimatedGradientText: colorFrom, colorTo, speed; AuroraText: colors, speed). ShineBorder and BorderBeam are animated border overlays: place inside a relative rounded-[Npx] parent with overflow-hidden (ShineBorder: shineColor, borderWidth, duration; BorderBeam: size, duration, colorFrom, colorTo). ShimmerButton and RainbowButton are premium CTA buttons, use them like Button with children as the label (ShimmerButton: background, shimmerColor, borderRadius; RainbowButton: variant, size). AvatarCircles shows social proof (props: avatarUrls=[{imageUrl, profileUrl}], numPeople). Iphone and Safari frame a screenshot image (Iphone: src; Safari: imageSrc, url for the address bar, width, height) — use for product shots.

sections.name: Aceternity UI
sections.usage: BentoGrid takes children. BentoGridItem takes title, description, and optional header (a ReactNode) and icon (a ReactNode, not a component reference).

charts.name: Bklit UI
charts.usage: Every chart takes data: { label: string; value: number }[] and a label string for accessibility. DonutChart also takes centerLabel and derives the center total from the data. Charts inherit brand color from currentColor — set it with a text-* class on the chart or an ancestor. Give each chart a sized container (for example h-48) because they fill their parent.
